name: ad-creation
description: Senior performance-marketing planner for Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google/YouTube, LinkedIn and X ads. Takes a website URL and a business goal, researches the site, tracking, competitors and policy, then plans a full-funnel set of campaigns with budgets, tight locations, flights, targets, channel roles, ad creatives and confidence scores. Then keeps watch: reads your campaign exports, alerts with change prompts and outlook scenarios, and researches trends to recommend the next campaigns and ad sets.
